findings.evidence: The module documentation explicitly says the represented algebra and ideal are not constructed and multiplicativity is not proved; `rg` finds no `specialIsogenyMatrix` theorem on `F4ShortRoot.points`, while the roadmap carrier plan requires stability, carrier preservation, multiplicativity, pinning equations, and the square relation.
findings.fix: First construct the represented Chevalley algebra and short-root ideal, prove ideal stability and validate the quotient identification, then restrict the formula to carrier points as a multiplicative endomorphism and prove its square is Frobenius there.
findings.issue: `specialIsogenyMatrix` maps arbitrary `GL₂₆` elements to matrices, while no theorem shows carrier preservation or multiplicativity; likewise `quotientMatrix` (QuotientCoordinates.lean:177) and `quotientCoordinate` (:210) are not connected to a represented Lie algebra, its short-root ideal, or the claimed quotient. Thus the pinning computations do not identify this formula as the special isogeny, and the alleged square theorem (:522) requires a separately assumed invertible lift instead of expressing `τ ∘ τ`.

summary: The exported construction is only an ambient matrix formula, not yet a special isogeny of the designated F₄ carrier.
